Une participation record pour la dixième: A record participation for the tenth edition of Seeds for the Future
Trente étudiants algériens ont rejoint S: Thirty Algerian students have arrived in Shenzhen, the tech metropolis in southern China, as part of the tenth edition of Seeds for the Future, Huawei's international digital training program. Announced on October 25, this participation represents the largest Algerian contingent ever sent since the initiative began in the country.
Le groupe se compose de jeunes sélection: The group consists of selected youths from institutions under four different ministries: Higher Education and Scientific Research, Post and Telecommunications, Interior and Local Authorities, and Vocational Training and Education. During their stay, participants alternate between theoretical classes, practical workshops, industrial site visits, and meetings with industry engineers.
La métropole de Shenzhen abrite des cent: The metropolis of Shenzhen is home to research centers, advanced production lines, and laboratories dedicated to artificial intelligence. This trip follows in the footsteps of previous Algerian achievements, recalling that last June, three students from USTHB, ENSTICP, and ENSIA won the global grand prize at the Huawei ICT Competition in Shenzhen against teams from over a hundred countries.
